description: This file implements core business logic for event management within a microservice architecture. It provides methods to create, configure, and retrieve events, integrating with persistence, validation, transformation, and logging components.

classes.name: EventService
classes.description: Implements application-specific business logic for managing events, including creating, configuring, and retrieving event data, with integrated validation, transformation, and error handling.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_event(self, event_data: dict)
methods.description: Validates input data, transforms it for persistence, inserts a new event into the database, and publishes a creation event to Kafka.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] configure_event(self, config_data: dict)
methods.description: Validates configuration data, updates the existing event record, and publishes configuration updates to Kafka.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_event(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an event by its ID, transforming database data into API-friendly format.

methods.description: Placeholder for publishing 'event created' messages to Kafka.

methods.description: Placeholder for publishing 'event configured' messages to Kafka.
